column1: # Interaction steps for the WLAN image: sent by the host runner in order, with
# the expected response after each; the judge verifies the responses in the
# received stream. One command per line, CR-terminated by the sender.
# Read-only checks only, and deliberately no `exit`: the round's operator
# appends the run's own commands after these through the runner's
# --steps-extra file (the connect command carries a credential, which must not
# live in this repository), and an early exit would close the shell those
# The help count for this image: the built-ins plus the WLAN and WPA commands.
